intent: Establish useful source-backed Karyoplast research orientation without adopting implementation work.

fields.summary: Karyoplast researches a shared learned numerical genome for persistent cells and eventual founder-to-population development. Status: documentation and Python scaffold only; no model, training, or adopted research plan. Cells have distinct state under shared weights; experts are components, and sequence grounding remains open. Start with README.md and AGENTS.md; docs/ecosystem.md records inspected interfaces and gaps; planning/open-questions.md and planning/roadmap.md guide the next bounded experiment. Architecture, state, time, division, gradients, and Cytoplast/FrameShift contracts remain unresolved.
